programme.title: O Grande Peixe
programme.desc: William Bloom regressa a casa para estar ao lado do pai, moribundo. William ouve uma e outra vez as histórias da sua juventude. Mas, desta vez, tenta averiguar coisas que lhe permitem conhecer melhor o seu pai, ainda que, para tal tenha de conseguir separar realidade e fantasia.

programme.title: As Mulherzinhas
programme.desc: Enquanto o pai se encontra a lutar na Guerra Civil, Joe, Meg, Beth e Amy crescem com a mãe em circunstâncias difíceis.

programme.title: A Dívida
programme.desc: Este thriller de espionagem começa em 1997 quando os ex-agentes secretos da Mossad, Rachel e Stefan, recebem notícias chocantes do antigo colega David.

programme.title: Push - Os Poderosos
programme.desc: A Divisão, uma organização governamental obscura, está a transformar geneticamente cidadãos em guerreiros psíquicos – e brutalmente dispostos a eliminar os que não queiram participar.

programme.title: Instinto Fatal
programme.desc: Um antigo cantor de rock aparece brutalmente assassinado na sua cama. O agente Nick Curran é encarregue da vigilância da noiva da vítima, Catherine Tramell, uma atractiva escritora bem sucedida na sua vida profissional e principal suspeita do crime.

programme.title: O Feitiço do Tempo
programme.desc: Phil, o apresentador do boletim metereológico de um canal de televisão, é enviado novamente a Punxstawnwey, para fazer a reportagem do festival anual do Dia da Marmota. Na viagem de volta, Phil e a sua equipa são surpreendidos por uma tempestade que os obriga a voltar à pequena cidade.

programme.title: Ler, Escrever e Amar
programme.desc: Por estar a passar dificuldades, o ator Wayne Wenders vê-se obrigado a procurar outras opções para pagar a renda que está cada vez mais atrasada… E a solução parece ser um biscate na escola secundária local, a ensinar Shakespeare aos alunos.

programme.title: Programa da Noite
programme.desc: Quando a mítica apresentadora de um famoso talk show, Katherine Newbury, é acusada de não contribuir para a causa feminina por trabalhar só com homens, ela contrata Molly, uma inexperiente jovem de origem indiana para colaborar no programa.

programme.title: Cidades de Papel

programme.title: Cozinha De Sotobosque T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Acompañamos a Catalina Skibinska a uno de sus cotos en Teruel para recechar Monteses afectados por la sarna. Nuestra protagonista nos explica cual es su punto de vista sobre el tema y como lo combaten.

programme.title: El Corzo Autonómico, Un Viaje Por España T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Turquía es unos de los mejores destinos para la caza de los grandes jabalies.Los míticos Attilas son el sueño de un grupo de cazadores españoles que viajan por primera vez al país asiático.

programme.title: Monteses Con Catalina
programme.desc: A pesca de carpas em águas frias nunca foi tarefa fácil. Neste episódio vamos até terras italianas, muito próximo de Veneza, onde a metereologia adversa vai-nos dar trabalho para localizar os peixes à chuva.

programme.title: Carpas À Chuva
programme.desc: Todos os anos, na Primavera, os barbos autóctones sobem a corrente para desovar nos rios cristalinos que correm para o Tejo. Ángel Delgado, um guia de pesca experiente que conhece estas águas como a palma da sua mão, mostra-nos os segredos da pesca à ninfa para este ciprinideo lutador.

programme.title: Wild Hunting T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Vamos pescar durante dois dias em lago de grande altitude, os lagos naturais de alta montanha dos Pireneus e vamos tentar capturar trutas e salvelinos. Levamos saco, tenda e todo o equipamento necessário para passarmos a noite na montanha. Uma aventura indomável.

programme.title: Os Barbos De Ibor
programme.desc: Raramente temos hipótese de caçar um trofeu record e menos ainda, temos a hipótese de o gravar. Na zona de Sul de Gredos um grande adepto da caça de montanha enfrenta o desafio de abater um velho macho que apenas se deixou ver nos ultimos 3 anos. um exemplar acima dos 280 pontos CIC. O possivel record desta zona de sul de Gredos.

programme.title: Escola De Barbos
programme.desc: Con las primeras lluvias de finales de agosto y sobre todo del mes de septiembre comienza el periodo del celo del ciervo. La berrea es el momento ideal para cazar los grandes ejemplares que ya han desarrollado todo su potencial.

programme.title: Wild Hunting T4 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Três apaixonantes jornadas a caçar galinholas em janeiro sem a ajuda das modernas coleiras eletrónicas. O nosso protagonista caça com os seus cães e os tradicionais ¿campanos¿ em terras salmantinas com os suas famosas azinheiras. Neste local de caça podemos desfrutar da caça a esta ave migratoria, talvez no mês mais duro da temporada, onde já encontramos muitos juvenis mais experientes que não dão a minima margem de erro.

programme.title: Caçadores De Javalis T7 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Tres pescadores nos enseñan a pescar en las cuatro estaciones del año. Lucios, truchas, percas y carpas son las protagonistas de esta temporada tanto a mosca, como spinning y casting.

programme.title: Do Campo De Tiro Para O Campo
programme.desc: A montaria, sem duvida, a modalidade de caça mais popular da península iberica está num momento de franca expansão. A diminuição da caça menor e o abandono do campo, que como consequência aumenta as superficies do monte, onde proliferam javalis e veados. Nas povoações da Extremadura realizam-se batidas e montarias com grande participação de caçadores, em terreno aberto.

programme.title: As Quatro Estações T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: A equipa de Certeros convida Antonio Adán e a Pilar Escribano a partilharem uma jornada de caça menor por terras andaluzes. Tordos e perdizes vão ser as protagonistas juntamente com uma receita de caça copiada por Enrique ao nosso indomável Maikol García.

programme.title: Surfcasting De Outono Com Humberto Gacio
programme.desc: El harris es un tipo de halcón americano ampliamente utilizado en cetrería por su facilidad de manejo y cría. Puede cazar juntos a otros harris siendo la caza de conejos y liebres sus presas habituales.

programme.title: La Cetrería: Patrimonio Inmaterial De La Humanidad T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Vamos pescar durante dois dias em lago de grande altitude, os lagos naturais de alta montanha dos Pireneus e vamos tentar capturar trutas e salvelinos. Levamos saco, tenda e todo o equipamento necessário para passarmos a noite na montanha. Uma aventura indomável.

programme.title: El Club De Los Monstruos: Payaras Gigantes
programme.desc: Neste episódio viajamos até à mítica barragem de Sierra Brava para aprender tudo sobre a pesca da carpa e sobretudo conhecer as novidades em tecnologia dos carretos e canas do mundo do CarpFishing.

programme.title: Monteses Con Catalina
programme.desc: A subida do barbo é um espetáculo natural aproveitado pelos pescadores.Vamos numa nova aventura de pesca à mosca. Para isso gravamos com Ruben, monitor de pesca de madrid e Beatriz uma alemã radicada em Espanha que decidiu ter aulas de pesca à mosca e aplicar os ensinamentos na pesca ao barbo.

programme.title: Top Water T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A montaria, sem duvida, a modalidade de caça mais popular da península iberica está num momento de franca expansão. programme.title: Peppermint
programme.desc: Riley North acorda de um coma após o assassinato do seu marido e da sua filha num brutal ataque à sua família. Quando o sistema protege os assassinos da justiça, Riley transforma-se numa verdadeira guerrilheira urbana, aplicando de forma metódica a sua forma muito pessoal de justiça.

programme.title: Pandemónio
programme.desc: Quando um vírus letal, capaz de tornar as pessoas extremamente violentas e selvagens, se alastra num edifício de escritórios, o advogado Derek Cho e uma cliente insatisfeita terão de unir esforços para lutar pela sobrevivência.

programme.title: The Loveless
programme.desc: Numa pequena cidade do sul dos EUA, um gangue de motoqueiros envolve-se em problemas enquanto se dirige para as corridas em Daytona.

programme.title: Não Olhes
programme.desc: Maria é uma estudante do ensino secundário em sofrimento pelas suas dificuldades de integração na escola e pelos problemas familiares. Mas tudo muda quando Maria troca de lugar com a figura sinistra que lhe surge no espelho…

programme.title: Índia Agridoce
programme.desc: Quando a caloira da faculdade Alia Kapur volta para casa no verão, ela descobre segredos e mentiras sobre o passado dos seus pais que a fazem questionar tudo o que ela achava que sabia sobre a sua família.

programme.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros
programme.desc: Ao lado de um jovem recruta ansioso por proteger o Rei de França, três leais espadachins tentam derrotar o pérfido conselheiro real e a sedutora espia enviada para derrubar a coroa.

programme.title: Alexandre, O Grande
programme.desc: Alexandre, Rei da Macedónia e um dos maiores líderes militares da história, conquista grande parte do mundo conhecido, mesmo que seja um homem dilacerado, desejando ansiosamente a aprovação do pai e continuando em conflito com o legado da mãe.

programme.title: Um Dia de Mãe
programme.desc: Com o Dia da Mãe prestes a chegar, as vidas de várias de mulheres de diversas idades vão cruzar-se, não só na relação que têm com as próprias mães como também no seu próprio papel de mães.

programme.title: O Legado
programme.desc: O patriarca de uma família rica e poderosa morre subitamente, deixando à sua filha um chocante legado secreto, que ameaça destruir a sua vida…

programme.title: O Melhor Homem
programme.desc: Um grupo de mercenários toma o controlo do hotel de um resort remoto durante um casamento e cabe ao padrinho, ao noivo e ao seu melhor amigo bêbado tentarem deter os terroristas e salvar os reféns.

programme.title: Um Ranger Especial
programme.desc: Alex Tyree é um Texas Ranger que persegue o assaltante de bancos Declan McBride através do deserto, quando descobre que ele é um terrorista internacional que tenciona detonar uma bomba no coração de Londres.

programme.title: Cidade Dividida
programme.desc: Na cidade de Nova Iorque, Billy Taggart, um ex-polícia caído em desgraça trabalha como investigador particular e é contratado pelo presidente da câmara de Nova Iorque, a quem deve um enorme favor, para espiar a sua mulher.

programme.title: Respect
programme.desc: De criança que cantava no coro da igreja onde o pai era pastor até ao reconhecimento internacional, “Respect” acompanha a notável história de vida da cantora e compositora norte-americana Aretha Franklin e a jornada que efetuou para encontrar sua voz.

programme.title: O Estrangeiro
programme.desc: Quando a sua filha adolescente é morta por uma bomba num atentado terrorista cometido pelo IRA, Quan, que fora treinado pelas forças especiais os EUA, não se vai deter perante nada para encontrar os culpados pelo atentado, por via de Liam Hennessy, atual deputado e antigo membro da organização.

programme.title: Domino - A Hora Da Vingança
programme.desc: Um polícia de Copenhaga procura fazer justiça pela morte de um colega que foi assassinado por um homem misterioso.

programme.title: Mafiosos
programme.desc: No sul os EUA, um xerife tenta manter a paz quando um homem de família desesperado e o seu irmão roubam violentamente um estabelecimento de distribuição semi-legal de fármacos, passando a ser também perseguidos por um executor da máfia de Nova Orleães.

programme.title: Como Rebentar Um Oleoduto
programme.desc: Uma equipa de ativistas ambientais traça um plano ousado para rebentar um oleoduto.

programme.title: Amesterdão
programme.desc: Na década de 1930, três amigos testemunham um crime, são acusados de o terem praticado acabam por desvendar uma das conspirações mais inacreditáveis da historia dos EUA.

programme.title: Rebobina E Ressaca
programme.desc: Um casal entra em crise quando a mulher, uma ´supermãe´ subestimada e em stress, sofre um colapso pós-traumático durante as festas de fim de ano que a leva a retomar a personalidade desvairada que tinha quando estava na universidade.

programme.title: Spencer
programme.desc: O casamento da Princesa Diana e do Príncipe Carlos há muito se transformou numa relação gélida. Entre rumores de casos extraconjugais e divórcio, o casal vai celebrar o Natal de 1991 na propriedade real de Sandringham House, onde o futuro de ambos se vai começar a definir.

programme.title: O Quadrado
programme.desc: Christian é o respeitado curador de um museu de arte contemporânea de Estocolmo, que tenta montar uma polémica instalação enquanto se encontra numa crise pessoal e profissional.

programme.title: Mile 22
programme.desc: Uma pequena equipa de elite de oficiais americanos, parte de uma unidade operações especiais e secretas, tem por missão levar para fora da Indonésia um misterioso agente da polícia com informações sensíveis.

programme.title: Timecop - Patrulha Do Tempo
programme.desc: Um oficial de uma agência de segurança que regula as viagens no tempo tem de lutar pela própria vida contra um político misterioso com uma ligação ao seu passado.

programme.title: Ruptura Explosiva
programme.desc: Johnny Utah é um caloiro do FBI a quem foi dada a missão de descobrir um bando de ladrões de bancos a operar no sul da Califórnia, que tudo indica que possa ser um grupo de surfistas. Quando ele se infiltra no grupo, conhece Bodhi, um viciado em adrenalina disposto a tudo para ter emoções fortes.

programme.title: Hércules - A Lenda Começa
programme.desc: Em 1200 a.C, na Grécia Antiga, o príncipe Hércules desconhece que é filho de Zeus e só deseja o amor da Princesa de Creta, prometida em casamento ao seu irmão. Agora, ele vai ter de fazer uma escolha: fugir com o seu verdadeiro amor ou cumprir o seu destino e tornar-se o grande herói do seu tempo.

programme.title: Crueldade Intolerável
programme.desc: Miles Massey é um advogado bem sucedido de Los Angeles, que vive aborrecido por não encontrar desafios à sua altura até ao dia em que encontra Marylin Rexroth, em breve a ex-mulher de um seu cliente rico e poderoso, ávida pela independência financeira que o divórcio lhe poderá trazer.

programme.title: Uma História Americana
programme.desc: Seymour “Swede” Levov, uma estrela do desporto na faculdade que agora é um empresário de sucesso, e a sua esposa Dawn Dwyer Levov, uma antiga rainha da beleza, veem a sua vida perfeita a desfazer-se quando a filha de ambos se envolve na turbulência da América dos anos 60.

programme.title: Mergulho Profundo
programme.desc: Após um acidente natural, uma viagem de mergulho na Noruega torna-se numa corrida contra o tempo para duas irmãs. Enquanto uma fica presa no fundo do mar, a outra fará de tudo para tentar salvar a irmã antes que o oxigénio acabe.

programme.title: Fidelidade Sem Limite
programme.desc: Com o brutal mundo do crime de Bruxelas como pano de fundo, Gigi, um gangster de aspirações elevadas, vive uma história de amor proibido com Bibi, uma jovem corredora de automóveis.

programme.title: Puccini - La bohème
programme.desc: In 2012, Norwegian opera director Stefan Herheim brought Giacomo Puccini's opera La bohème to the stage of the Norwegian National Opera in Oslo. About his choice for this updated version, Herheim explained: “In bringing La bohème into a present-day setting with this new production we hope to revive the immediate power of suggestion and importance that this work at one time revelled in.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 3
programme.desc: Due to its 95-minute duration, Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 3 is an imposing and mysterious work. This 1992 performance, directed by Bernhard Haitink, includes the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, the Tölzer Knabenchor, and the Ernst Senff Choir. During the six parts of this wonderful symphony, Mahler expresses his musical vision of nature and mankind's place in it.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Hector Berlioz’ ‘Symphonie Fantastique’.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 5, Op. 47
programme.desc: Maestro Jaap van Zweden conducts the Orchestre de Paris in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 5 in D minor, Op. 47. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, on March 9, 2016.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Wolf, Debussy a. o.
programme.desc: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Wolf, Debussy a. o.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: German Brass goes Bach
programme.desc: The German Brass ensemble delivers some of Bach's most popular tunes in breathtaking brass arrangements. Recorded live from the magnificent St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, this concert features timeless pieces by the legendary German composer, such as Toccata and Fugue in D minor, Adagio in G minor, and Jesus bleibet meine Freude.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 1, Op. 23
programme.desc: Roberto Giordano performs Chopin's Ballade No. 1, Op. 23. The sketches of the work date back to 1831 during Chopin's eight-month stay in Vienna. The first ballade was completed in 1835 after the composer moved to Paris.

programme.title: Rossini - Petite messe solennelle
programme.desc: Gioacchino Rossini's Petite Messe Solennelle was written in 1863, 'the last', the composer called it, of my 'péchés de vieillesse' (sins of old age). For its first performance (1864) Rossini arranged the work with only two pianos and harmonium. Partly for fear that it would be done anyway after his death, Rossini discreetly orchestrated the Petite Messe Solennelle during 1866-67, without losing its candor and subtlety.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Schubert, Schumann et al.
programme.desc: Soprano Harriet Burns (United Kingdom, 1989) and pianist Ian Tindale (United Kingdom, 1990) perform Franz Schubert’s Verklärung, D. 59; Clara Schumann’s Er ist gekommen in Sturm und Regen, Op. 12, No. 2; ‘L’heure exquise’ from Reynaldo Hahn’s Chansons grises, and ‘Le printemps’ from Hahn’s Douze rondels; ‘Herzeleid’ from Robert Schumann’s Sechs Gesänge, Op.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Bach - The Well-Tempered Clavier No. 24
programme.desc: In 1722, when Johann Sebastian Bach lived in Köthen, Germany, he published a book of preludes and fugues in all 24 major and minor keys. This collection became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book One, BWV 846–869. About two decades later, Bach compiled a second book in Leipzig, which became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book Two, BWV 870-893.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Documentary 2017
programme.desc: This short documentary follows the participants of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world. In doing so, it has become one of the prominent gateways to the international professional classical music scene for young musicians.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff And Dvorák Trios
programme.desc: The Valerius Ensemble, consisting of Eeva Koskinen (violin), René Geesing (cello) and Ingo Lulofs (piano) plays Rachmaninoff’s Trio élégiaque Nr. 1 and the Finale of Dvorák’s Piano Trio No.3, Op. 65. Rachmaninoff composed this Trio in 1892 at the age of 19. The work does not have an opus number and consists only of one movement, which is highly unusual for a Piano Trio.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece’s premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Brahms - The 3 Violin Sonatas, Op. 78, 100 And 108
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final II: Mozart, Liszt and Franck
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw
programme.desc: Since his spectacular debut recital at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in 2002, pianist Misha Fomin has become an indispensable part of Dutch musical life. National and international press praise his playing for its fluently natural virtuosity, rich color palette, and great musical intelligence.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Peter and the Wolf
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Sergei Prokofiev’s Peter and the Wolf, Op. 67. Written in 1936, Peter and the Wolf is a short, narrated orchestral suite, telling the story of a brave boy named Peter, who lives with his grandfather on the edge of a forest.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Swan Lake (2015)
programme.desc: The Imperial Ice Stars are an ensemble of 24 world class skaters, holding more than 300 competition medals between them. Praised by critics and audiences alike, they never fail to enchant with creative and powerful story-telling, sumptuous sets, spectacular special effects and opulent costumes.

programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. Founded in 1947 by Monza-born pianist Rina Sala Gallo and Brescia-born pianist Arturo Benedetti Michelangeli, the competition is one of Monza’s most prestigious cultural events today.

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Puccini - Tosca
programme.desc: For the Easter Festival 2017 in Baden-Baden, Sir Simon Rattle and the Berliner Philharmoniker draw their inspiration from Tosca, the most well-known and most brilliant of all the Puccini operas. And that is deservedly so since Tosca is not merely a work of art, but also a gripping suspense-packed story. The opera premiered in 1900 at the Teatro Costanzi in Rome.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 4 in D major, K. 218. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Villa-Lobos - String Quartet No. 16
programme.desc: Quarteto Radamés Gnattali performs Heitor Villa-Lobos's String Quartet No. 16 at the Palácio das Laranjeiras in Rio de Janiero, Brasil. The ensemble was founded in 2006 and consists of Carla Rincón and Francisco Roa (violins), Fernando Thebaldi (viola), and Hugo Pilger (cello). The quartet, which specializes in Brazilian music, focuses on educational activities.

programme.title: Donizetti - L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza conducts the Orchestra Gli Originali and the Coro Donizetti Opera in a performance of Geatano Donizetti’s comic opera L’elisir d’amore (‘The Elixer of Love’, 1832). L’elisir d’amore is perhaps the most famous work in Donizetti’s extensive repertoire. It tells the story of the poor peasant Nemorino who is in love with the beautiful landowner Adina.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2000 from Berlin
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev (piano), Karita Mattila (soprano), Violeta Urmana (alto), Thomas Moser (tenor), Eike Wilm Schulte (bass), Swedish Radio Choir, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir, Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, conductor: Claudio Abbado. Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Piano Concerto No. 2 in B flat major, Op. 19 - Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret?

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, 'Emperor'
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73, famously known as the ‘Emperor’ Concerto. Italian pianist Beatrice Rana features as the soloist here. The New York Times describes her as ‘one of the most insightful and prodigiously gifted artists of the new generation’.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Brahms, Britten a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Vassia Alati (the Netherlands/Greece, 1992) and pianist Yuto Kiguchi (Japan, 1989) perform ‘C’est l’extase langoureuse’ from Claude Debussy’s Arriettes oubliées, L. 63, and ‘Fantoches’ from Debussy’s Fêtes galantes, L. 86; Bart Visman’s Het goud van Vermeer; ‘Lerchengesang’ from Johannes Brahms’s Vier Gesänge, Op. 70; Franz Schubert’s Gruppe aus dem Tartarus, Op. 24, No. 1, D.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach - Cello Suite No. 5 in C minor, BWV 1011
programme.desc: At St. Bartholomew Church in Dornheim, Germany, where composer Johann Sebastian Bach married his first wife Maria Barbara, renowned Dutch cellist Anner Bijlsma performs the composer's Cello Suite No. 5 in C minor, BWV 1011. It is likely Bach wrote his collection of six Suites for unaccompanied cello during the years 1717-1723.

programme.title: Mussorgsky - Night on Bald Mountain
programme.desc: Young Euro Classic is the world’s most important platform for international young orchestra musicians in the European classical music tradition, and for its development. For 17 days every summer, orchestras from all over the world perform at Berlin’s Konzerthaus, on Gendarmenmarkt. This performance features some highlights of the Young Euro Classic edition of 2016.

programme.title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach.

programme.title: Bach - Cantata 'Ich habe genug', BWV 82
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Memory of a Concert
programme.desc: In 2006, Gidon Kremer and Martha Argerich set out on tour performing solos and duets by Bartók und Schumann. The last of the concert series at the Berliner Philharmonie has been recorded for this film, featuring a rare solo performance by Martha Argerich. A concert film with personal and moving commentary by Gidon Kremer. Program: Schumann's Violin Sonata No. 1, Op. 10, Violin Sonata No. 2, Op. 121; Kinderszenen, Op.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: On November 14, 1987, a promising conductor made his Berlin Philharmonic debut with Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 6: Simon Rattle. In retrospect Rattle says, “I felt that I was finding my voice on that day.” Mahler’s multifaceted work is now again on the program when Sir Simon appears for the last time as chief conductor of the Berliner Philharmoniker in the Philharmonie in 2018. The wheel comes full circle. Mahler's Symphony No.

programme.title: Baroque works by Bach, Muffat and Rameau
programme.desc: Paul Goodwin conducts the Conjunto Barroco of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid in a Baroque music program featuring works by Georg Muffat, J. S. Bach, and Jean-Philippe Rameau. On the program are Muffat’s Sonata No. 5 in G major, 'Armonico tributo'; Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; and Rameau’s Suite from the opera ‘Les Boréades’.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Quintet in E-flat major, Op. 44
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra.

programme.title: Niccolò Jommelli - Requiem
programme.desc: In 1754, Jommelli took up the position of “Ober-Kapellmeister” at the ducal court of Stuttgart. There he wrote not only operas, serenatas and pastorales but also religious music for special occasions. One example is his Requiem, a musical farewell to the mother of Jommelli’s patron. Counterpoint German style, French ornamentation, and Italian drama come together in this unique blend, which clearly bears Naples’ signature.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4, Op. 98
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts The Cleveland Orchestra in this performance of Brahms' Symphony No. 4. This is the final of the composer's short selection of symphonic works. Described by music critic Malcolm Macdonald as one of the “supreme creative acts of the Romantic era,” Brahms' Fourth Symphony is endowed with a strong undercurrent of subdued melancholy. It seems to pine for an irretrievable past.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 10
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love.

programme.title: Berlioz - The Damnation of Faust
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust. La damnation de Faust is a work born of the composer’s obsession with Goethe’s legendary tale. Once a righteous scholar, Faust allows himself to be corrupted by the devil, and drags the innocent around him into desperation and death.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Derek Wang
programme.desc: Pianist Derek Wang (USA, 1998) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro, of Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No 1. in G minor, Op. 25. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM).

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Holst - The Planets
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Nationaal Vrouwen Jeugdkoor in a performance of Gustav Holst’s The Planets, Op. 32, recorded at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Nutcracker 2011
programme.desc: This stunning performance of theatrical ice dancing brings viewers into the enchanting world of Tchaikovsky's magnificent holiday classic, The Nutcracker On Ice, performed by the internationally renowned Imperial Ice Stars, and including former champion figure skaters, Vadim Yarkov and Olga Sharutenko. This very special performance and soundtrack was performed by the Manchester Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Tim A.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: Europa Konzert 2004 – Athens
programme.desc: Europakonzert 2004 was held in Athens, Greece. This concert featured the Berliner Philharmoniker performing live at the ancient Herodes Atticus Theatre along with an interesting combination of conductor and soloist - Sir Simon Rattle wielding the baton as pianist Daniel Barenboim plays Johannes Brahms’ Piano Concerto No. 1 and Arnold Schoenberg's arrangement of Brahms' Piano Quartet No 1.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Bernard Haitink conducts the Berliner Philharmoniker at the Easter Festival in Baden-Baden, 2015. On the program is Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68. The composer wrote his Symphony No. 6 between 1802 and 1808. Nicknamed 'Pastoral Symphony,' this piece is one of the few examples of program music for the German composer.

programme.title: Minha Terra Minha Gente
programme.desc: “Minha Terra, Minha Gente” apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. São empolgantes histórias de vida que personificam o amor à terra. Memórias das pessoas e dos locais, para as gerações futuras, com testemunhos marcantes e inspiradores de gente apaixonada: usos, costumes e tradições do rico património de Portugal. .

programme.title: Meia Maratona Douro Vinhateiro
programme.desc: A Meia Maratona do Douro Vinhateiro é muito mais do que uma corrida — é uma experiência única no coração de uma das paisagens mais deslumbrantes do mundo. Realiza-se ao longo das margens do Rio Douro, entre vinhas em socalcos classificadas como Património Mundial da UNESCO.Conhecida como “A Mais Bela Corrida do Mundo”, atrai atletas de dezenas de países e oferece um percurso que combina desafio, beleza natural e um ambiente vibrante.

Aqui, a tradição é viva e respira-se em todos os corredores.Neste episódio do “Feira Semanal”, Marcos Pinto percorre o terreiro onde a feira acontece há séculos, num cenário que mistura o encanto medieval com a simplicidade do dia-a-dia.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 34
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nubiyan Twist - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, the band Nubiyan Twist performs at the International Music Meeting Festival.

programme.title: Blicher Hemmer Gadd - A Music documentary
programme.desc: Award-winning saxophonist Michael Blicher, Hammond wizard Dan Hemmer and legendary drummer Steve Gadd joined forces in 2014 to celebrate their shared love for Hammond-organ soul jazz. The band, which tours extensively throughout the world, has released several albums. Their third album, which was released in November 2019, features U.K. vocalist Paul Carrack on the soulful ballad 'The First One To Know'.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Ben Sluijs
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content. Saxophonist Ben Sluijs received a classical training.

programme.title: Marius Neset - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. In 2019, one of them is Copenhagen-based Norwegian saxophonist Marius Neset, who is known internationally for his collaborations with People Are Machines, Kaktusch, JazzKamikaze, and Django Bates' projects StoRMChaser and Human Chain.

programme.title: Germeringer Jazztage: Paco de Lucía And Group
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: On Broadway
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Kenny G - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, smooth jazz saxophonist and crowd-favorite Kenny G serenaded those attending the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Ostrich Quartet
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Festival Vue sur la Relève: SHPIK
programme.desc: Montreal's very own jazz group SHPIK offers a bold and impressionistic music, drawing its inspirations from jazz, nature, and film. Evoking the great outdoors, self-discovery, and navigating between the immense and the infinitely small, this first album offers an intricate musical journey that is both energetic and reflective.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Tambours de Brazzas
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Jeroen van Vliet Moon Trio
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Morgenland Festival: One Way Ticket to Damascus
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: View From The Outside
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Milt Jacksons' Modern Jazz Quartet at the Bozar
programme.desc: The Modern Jazz Quartet (MJQ) was composed of Milt 'Bags' Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums. Milt Jackson and John Lewis were pioneer bebop musicians who had played together in Dizzy Gillespie's 1948 big band. They pursued separate careers before adding Heath and Lewis to form the Modern Jazz Quartet in the 1950s.

programme.title: Ellen Pels - Love 2/2
programme.desc: Dutch jazz singer Ellen Pels presents her latest release, “Love.” Recorded live at Theater Odeon in Zwolle, the Netherlands, Ellen is joined by The Red Limo String Quartet and her own nine-piece rhythm section. The singer combines her passionate love for music with her own, stirring lyrics, inspired by spiritual philosophers like Paulo Coelho, Eckhard Tolle, and Deepak Chopra.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Trio Florizoone - Massot
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the trio Massot/Florizoone/Horbaczewski.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: TorTube: Dual City Concert Band ft. Hermine Deurlo
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Fine and Mellow
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: Portrait: Open Source Trio
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel - Bandit 65
programme.desc: Jazzfest Bonn is an annual festival of modern and creative jazz music. Every May it presents local and international jazz musicians in concert halls all over the German city. Among the artists of the 2017 edition is Bandit 65, a trio of breathtaking virtuosity, great power, boundless breadth, and astounding beauty.

programme.title: Martin Fabricius Trio - Under the Same Sky
programme.desc: Martin Fabricius is a Danish vibraphonist and composer of film music who studied with the legendary vibes master Gary Burton. Ever since Fabricius' first album in 2008, he has performed his own music all over the world, attracting a growing audience of listeners both familiar and new to jazz. Fabricius is also a sought after guest soloist and sideman and has played with legendary trumpet player Tomasz Stanko and bassist Steve Swallow.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Benjamin Herman - Sonny Rollins
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Maria João Quartet
programme.desc: In this recording, the Portuguese singer Maria João makes her appearance at the Bayerischer Hof Night Club during the 1999 Münchner Klaviersommer. She is accompanied by Marcio Doctor (percussion), Miroslav Tadic (guitar), and her long-standing partner, the brilliant pianist Mário Laginha. Maria is known for her vocal flexibility and improvisational skills.

programme.title: Sven Hammond Soul: Tivoli de Helling
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the soundtrack of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Dilemma
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah, West Of The West
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Kapok
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Georgie Fame And the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its RAndB, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove’ is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Fanfaraï
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks and Co: Estival 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist.

programme.title: A$AP Rocky And A$AP Ferg - At The Hordern Pavilion
programme.desc: Big hits, booty dancing, stage dives, fan freestyles and of course, controversy, A$AP Rocky's debut Down Under tour had it all! At his sold-out Sydney show, hip hop's hottest star and 5000 rowdy fans got wild for the night at the Hordern Pavilion and we captured it all exclusively.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Breaking Point
programme.desc: In 1988, Dee Dee Bridgewater was one of the first great jazz singers to perform at the Jazz Festival in Ramatuelle. In 2016, the story seems to repeat itself as her daughter China Moses took the stage at Ramatuelle. Over the years, China Moses has become a mature performer with a unique style: rocky voice, sharp sense of swing, and intense/energetic stage presence.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: Clark Terry Big Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Tigran Hamasyan And Mathias Eick - November Music
programme.desc: November Music, a Dutch music festival in ’s-Hertogenbosch, showcases today's prominent composers. It programs top-notch ensembles, jazz and world music pioneers, interdisciplinary concerts, and sound art. In 2019, Tigran Hamasyan and Mathias Eick played a duo performance here. Armenian pianist Hamasyan has claimed a category of his own in contemporary jazz. Norwegian trumpeter Mathias Eick is an undisputed master of his instrument.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Session: From Rossini to Piazzolla
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: The Art of Duo
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Hi-Fi-Fo-Fum
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Episode 3: Miles Davis - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell’Arte in Milan.

programme.title: Os Capoeira - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Os Capoeira.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: Moanin'
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Invisible World - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Bakolo Music International - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Django Reinhardt Tribute: Beets And Rosenberg
programme.desc: The treasured compositions of guitarist Django Reinhardt, the founding father of hot club jazz, are engraved in everyone's memory. Although Reinhardt missed two fingers of his left hand, his virtuoso technique was unrivalled. Dutch guitarist Stochelo Rosenberg and pianist Peter Beets now have the pleasure to bring Django’s music back to life with their infectious improvisations.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Bertus Borgers And The Young Retro's
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: H. Jones, J. Woode, C. Lucas - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Episode 2 of 4.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 108
programme.desc: Gerluce Maria das Graças integra uma família de mães solo: é filha de Lígia Maria e mãe de Joélly Maria. Criada pela mãe, que engravidou na adolescência e foi abandonada pelo seu pai, Gerluce enfrenta um destino parecido com a chegada da filha.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 109
programme.desc: Jorginho fica emocionado ao ouvir um choro de criança. Herculano tenta tranquilizar Lena. Samira avisa a Lena que a criança nasceu bem, e ameaça não entregar o bebê caso ela apareça na clínica. Jorginho finge passar mal e aproveita a distração de Edilberto para desarmá-lo. Pastor Albérico acalma Lígia. Raul se desespera ao não poder ver a filha. Arminda pensa em pegar a neta.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 110
programme.desc: Samira manda o médico deixar Joélly na porta de um hospital e leva a criança com ela. Gerluce tem um mau pressentimento com Joélly. Lucélia dá informações a Ferette sobre Lorena e Juquinha em troca de dinheiro. Samira entrega a criança a Lena e Herculano, e orienta que o casal deva sair de casa por uns dias. Paulinho avisa a Gerluce que Joélly está no posto de saúde sem o bebê.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 111
programme.desc: Lucélia induz Lorena e Juquinha a acreditar que Kasper esteja envolvido com drogas. Gerluce encontra Joélly. Paulinho diz a Gerluce que roubaram a filha de Joélly. Rogério promete a Raul que encontrará a neta. Lígia fica surpresa com o apoio de Joaquim. Samira garante a Arminda e Ferette que o casal que comprou a criança deixará o país.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 112
programme.desc: Lucélia induz Lorena e Juquinha a acreditar que Kasper esteja envolvido com drogas. Gerluce encontra Joélly. Paulinho diz a Gerluce que roubaram a filha de Joélly. Rogério promete a Raul que encontrará a neta. Lígia fica surpresa com o apoio de Joaquim. Samira garante a Arminda e Ferette que o casal que comprou a criança deixará o país.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 113
programme.desc: Paulinho ampara Gerluce e Joélly. Raul está determinado a ir atrás de Samira e desfazer o acordo. Raul não aceita o dinheiro de Samira e avisa que não desistirá da filha. Xênica escuta a conversa entre Raul e Samira. Raul avisa que denunciará Samira.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 114
programme.desc: Joélly finge não se lembrar de quem a levou para a clínica. Macedo mostra imagens de Viviane destruindo a Casa de Farinha ao lado de Leonardo. Ferette comenta com Macedo que provará que Rogério era o chefe do esquema dos remédios falsos. Rogério pressiona Raul para contar a verdade sobre a criança. Jairo avisa a Paulinho que Lena e o marido deixaram o país.

programme.title: Malhação - 2014 T22 - Ep. 219

programme.title: Palavras Que Rimam
